headlines.headline: Upcoming IPOs with shareholder quota: Reliance Retail, JSW One, IGX, Mahanadi Coalfields & more
headlines.summary: Many investors applied for the Jio Platforms IPO under the shareholder quota, which was reserved for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders. Mahanadi Coalfields, South Eastern Coalfields, Indian Gas Exchange, and Reliance Retail are among the list of upcoming IPOs likely to have a shareholder quota.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank reclaims 61,000: HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Federal Bank, other banking stocks rally up to 6%; here's why
headlines.summary: Banking stocks surging up to 6% powered the NIFTY Bank index to reclaim its position above 61,000 levels, near its lifetime high, as investors focus on the broader market rally amid FII buying support.

headlines.headline: HUL, ONGC, Godfrey Phillips, IRB Infra dividend record date on Nov 12: Last day to buy for payout
headlines.summary: HUL has declared an interim dividend of ₹19 per share, with a face value of ₹1 per share, for FY27. The record date is November 12. The company will pay the dividend to shareholders on November 25.

headlines.headline: Crude oil at 2-month low: HPCL, BPCL, Asian Paints, IndiGo shares rally; here's why
headlines.summary: Brent crude futures fell $1.08, or 1.2%, to settle at $91.49 per barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude declined 81 cents, or 0.9%, to $86.04 per barrel on Tuesday.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX rally over 1% after opening higher, IndiGo, M&M, among gainers; check factors behind today's surge
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices rallied over 1% after opening higher on Wednesday, November 11, with key focus on lower crude oil prices, massive FII buying support and positive geopolitical sentiment in the market.

headlines.headline: HUL raises prices, Dabur signals increase: Is India's FMCG sector entering a new pricing cycle?
headlines.summary: HUL has raised the maximum retail prices (MRPs) of several products across its home care portfolio, including popular detergent brands Surf Excel, Rin and Wheel, by up to 11%, amid continued cost pressures and efforts to protect margins.

headlines.headline: Can Reliance Industries disrupt India’s biscuit market like cola? Britannia CEO weighs in; stocks in focus
headlines.summary: Reliance Consumer Products Ltd (RCPL), the FMCG arm of RIL, has expanded its Independence biscuit portfolio with 28 new stock-keeping units (SKUs) across nine variants.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers on Nov 9: SBI, Trent up 2%, Nestle gains 1.9%; Tata Steel, HCL Tech drop over 2% among top movers
headlines.summary: As the equity indices end higher after a turbulent session on November 9, stocks like SBI, Trent, and Nestle India emerged as top gainers, while others like Tata Steel, and IT stocks among others were subject to selling pressure.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 9: SENSEX rises 107 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 25,044 as PSU Bank, pharma stocks rally; SBI leads gains
headlines.summary: The market breadth was in favour of declines as 1,959 out of 3,698 traded stocks ended session in red.

headlines.headline: SBI, PNB, Bank of Baroda: NIFTY PSU Bank index rallies up to 3.7% amid weak market; what’s powering PSU bank stocks?
headlines.summary: State-owned banking stocks or PSU banks surged during the trading session on Monday, November 9, as investors focused on the sectoral capital rotation into domestic value buying bets amid the overall profit-booking sentiment in the market.

headlines.headline: L&T bags order worth up to ₹2,500 crore from Noida Metro Rail Corporation; shares trade higher
headlines.summary: The project is expected to play a crucial role in supporting Noida’s expanding urban landscape and is likely to be completed within a stringent timeline of 36 months.

headlines.headline: NIFTY, SENSEX continue to trade lower in noon deals; HDFC Bank, SBI, L&T, PVR Inox, Divi's Labs among top buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: In the NIFTY50 firms, Tata Steel, HCLTech, UltraTech Cement, Infosys, Bharti Airtel, ITC, Bajaj Finance and Grasim, among others, were among the major laggards.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50 fails to sustain 25,000, SENSEX declines 260 points after positive open; IT stocks among top losers
headlines.summary: NIFTY50 failed to sustain 25,000 levels, while the SENSEX declined over 260 points after opening higher on Monday, November 9, as IT stocks dragged the benchmark indices into negative territory during the early hours.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank shares jump 2%, rally 12% in a month: Is leadership reset reviving investor confidence?
headlines.summary: The recent rally comes amid hopes that the appointment of Anup Bagchi as the bank's new MD and CEO will help restore investor confidence and steer the country's largest private sector lender through a challenging phase.

headlines.headline: Market weekly wrap: SENSEX jumps 6,568 pts, NIFTY50 rallies 9% as FIIs return; top factors explained
headlines.summary: Brent crude prices fell more than 16% over the week, touching a low of $93.22 per barrel before closing at $97.75 per barrel on Friday.
